title: The design and record justified the upload-artifact pin by a two-week age rule that no repository document states
resolution: Removed the rule reference in design.md and verification.md and kept the observed publish date and age.

title: An early setup failure made the always-run upload fail a second time because the evidence directory did not exist
resolution: The upload runs only when the environment step ran; the requirement now says the artifact is uploaded even when a proof fails.
